notes.spotbugs:UUF_UNUSED_FIELD#startLine: the captured SARIF result for this field-level bug has no 'region' at all (only artifactLocation, no startLine) because SpotBugs does not attach a source line to field-only bug patterns. The already-implemented normaliser (packages/shared/src/sarif/normalize.ts, resolveLocation) defaults a missing region's startLine to 1 (Math.max(1, r?.startLine ?? 1)); startLine 1 pins that real, already-shipped pipeline behaviour, verified by running normalizeSarif on the committed sample (no FINDING_PATH_INVALID warning; findings[1].location.startLine === 1). Mapping field-level bugs to their real declaration line (Calculator.java:4) instead of defaulting to 1 would require SpotBugs-specific enhancement (e.g. resolving the field's line from source/bytecode debug info) that the normaliser does not do today; that is left as a Phase 1 CLI/SpotBugs-mapping enhancement, not something this fixture should assert
notes.spotbugs:UUF_UNUSED_FIELD#overlap: the same field (unusedCounter) is also reported by PMD's UnusedPrivateField at the same path (line 4, since PMD's own SARIF does carry a real region for this rule); both are genuine, independently-verified findings from different engines and both are listed since findingsExhaustive is true
